verdict.rationale: three.js ships its own hash-routed API reference at threejs.org/docs, with per-class pages such as OrbitControls and GLTFLoader. It also hosts a browser-runnable examples gallery (threejs.org/examples, e.g. #webgl_animation_keyframes) and an in-browser editor. However, the evidence never shows runnable examples embedded in, or linked from, the reference pages themselves, and the hash routing leaves no per-page static URLs. Missing for 10: evidence that reference pages are interactive or embed live, editable examples; explicit cross-linking from API entries to runnable demos; independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
